title: The four-cycle conjecture for the abelian loop
statement:
Let $S$ be the abelian loop of odd numbers used in the paper, with binary operation $\bullet$. Consider quartets $(a,b,c,d)$ of distinct numbers in $S$ satisfying

$$
a \bullet b=b \bullet c=c \bullet d=d \bullet a.
$$

**Four-cycle conjecture.** There are infinitely many such quartets.

This conjecture concerns four-cycles in the operation table of the loop. The supplied text does not provide evidence resolving it, so its status remains open.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.14716

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of October 2021).
source_name: Raghavendra N. Bhat, “An Abelian Loop for Non-Composites”, arXiv:2110.14716 (2024).
